page.overview:
What is Hindar?

Hindar is a sacred grove on the island of Hindarsfjall, in the Skellige archipelago.

Freya's Garden is a large sanctuary that was built by the locals of Hindarsfjall a long time ago. Recently, the priestesses were almost all butchered during one of their ceremonies by a local bandit named Morkvarg.
